# Bayline Digital

> Bayline Digital Inc. is a Toronto-based web design and automation studio serving growing businesses across Ontario. The company builds conversion-focused websites, landing pages, custom web applications, local SEO systems, and lead-follow-up automation.

Canonical website: https://www.baylinedigital.com
Contact: contact@baylinedigital.com
Phone: +1-613-818-8550
Service area: Toronto and Ontario, Canada

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.baylinedigital.com/): Overview of Bayline Digital and its approach.
- [Services](https://www.baylinedigital.com/services): Website, conversion, automation, SEO, and support services.
- [Industries](https://www.baylinedigital.com/industries): Solutions for home-service companies, marketing firms, and B2B organizations.
- [Blog](https://www.baylinedigital.com/blog): Practical guidance about websites, local SEO, conversion, and automation.
- [Contact](https://www.baylinedigital.com/contact): Start a project or request a website review.

## Services

- [Custom CMS websites](https://www.baylinedigital.com/services/custom-websites): Custom Next.js websites with structured content management.
- [Landing pages](https://www.baylinedigital.com/services/landing-pages): Focused pages for advertising campaigns and lead generation.
- [Custom web applications](https://www.baylinedigital.com/services/web-apps): Internal tools, operational dashboards, and workflow applications.
- [Lead automation](https://www.baylinedigital.com/services/automation): Form, inbox, CRM, notification, and follow-up integrations.
- [Local SEO](https://www.baylinedigital.com/services/seo): Technical SEO, local landing pages, structured data, and search foundations.
- [Maintenance and hosting](https://www.baylinedigital.com/services/maintenance): Ongoing support, deployment, monitoring, and improvements.
